Morris Abraham Cohen, 4I, was born in London of Jewish 
parents on 3.8.1887. While he was s£fil1 of school age, 
his family moved to Alberta, Canada, He now consiiers 
himself to be a Canadian and appears to be scqueinted 
with @ large mimber of politicians in that country. 
Reports received from Shanghai state that his career in 
Canada was marked by connections with professional gamblers 
and shady real estate business. He removed frou Canada to 
the U.S.A, and spent several years in New York, It was in 
America that’ he first met the late Dr. SUN YAT SEN about 
the year I9I0. Since then he has been closely connected © 
with the activities of the Kuomintang political party in 
China, 

Cohen was in Canada at the outbreak of the Great War, 
and there assisted in the organisation of the Chi nese 
Labour Corps. He later proceeded to Bngland and France 


with a railway battalion. After the war he returned to 


the U.S.A. ani resumed his 014 relations with the Canadian 
branch of the Kuomintang. In 1925. he proceeded to Canton 
at the instance of the Kuomintang party in Alberta, On 
arrival in Canton he became the personal bodyguard to Dr. 
SUN YAT SEN. Since then he has visited the U.S.A, several 
times on Kuomintang business. His visits to U.S.A, were 
probably with the intention of collecting funds for the 
Kuomintang party, but HoB.M. Consul-General at Canton 
wrote in 1925 that he was of opinion that smuggling of 
Chinese into the North American Continent was probably 
Cohen's real ain. , 

When Dr. SUN YAT SEN died in March 1925, Cohen was 
unemployed fcr some time. In July 1925 he was acting as a 
sort of liason officer for the Commissioner of Police, 
Canton, and later made several trips to Shanghai and the 
North -in connection with projects for extending ‘the

DENIAL IN COURT OF

Captain John Bell, a director of
the Boley Armament Company, was
the principal Thursday gave evidence
before the Arms Commission, was a
witness at the Old Bailey on
February 7.

Alexander Herbert Tucker (48)
and Montague Wentworth (48) were
charged with conspiracy to defraud,
and trying to obtain £1,000 by false
pretences from Commander Charles
Belling St. John Rich, R.N. (retired).
Wentworth was discharged at the
conclusion of the case for the prose-
cution, the jury agreeing there was
no case against him.

Captain Bell said that he inter-
viewed Tucker last autumn in con-
nection with arms for China, but
nothing came of it. He never had a
contract with his firm.

Captain Bell agreed that Tucker
introduced him to a General Cohen.

The Common Serjeant (Mr. Cecil
Whiteley, K.C.): What was he a
general in?

Captain Bell: The Chinese army.
Captain Bell said that at the time
General Cohen, who had considerable
influence in the army in Southern
China, was in England.

An intermediary named Brockdorf
had authority to act for his firm in
issuing a letter to Tucker or General
Cohen that if an order for arms were
given, together with the necessary
permit from the Chinese Government,
they would supply the arms, provid-
ed the Board of Trade would issue
the necessary export licence.

Nothing came of the interview with
General Cohen.

Tucker gave accounts of his meet-
ing with Mr. Brockdorf, who con-
vinced him he was an agent for the
Boley Armament Company. Brock-
dorf, he said, asked him to assist in
the sale of armaments, telling him
there were big profits in such transac-
tions.

He (Tucker) interviewed General
Cohen in London and was told he did
not know whether anything would
come of it.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17, 1929

GENERAL COHEN IN
CANTON NOW

Personal Bodyguard of the Late
Dr. Sun Yat-sen Revisits
City

Amongst the personages of interest who have recently arrived in Canton is General Maurice A. Cohen, who is closely connected with the Nationalist Government of China at Nanking, writes the Canton correspondent of the "Hongkong Telegraph." General Cohen was for a long time personal body-guard of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen. Since the death of Dr. Sun, he has been very closely connected with political movements in Canton and South China. Last year, he went to Paris and London with Mr. Hu Han-min and Mr. Sun Fo, and was received by Sir Austen Chamberlain and other important members of the British Government.

Returning to Canton at the end of last year, General Cohen remained here for about three months, until in March this year he was called north to Nanking and Peking in connection with the state burial of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen. It is notable that General Cohen was the only foreigner who travelled from Peking to Nanking on Dr. Sun's funeral train.

Since that time, General Cohen has been closely connected with the Ministry of Finance of the Nationalist Government. He is on a visit to Canton on official business. Though he would not disclose the nature of his business, it is surmised that it has to do with the re-establishment on the Central Bank notes for the province of Kuangtung.

When questioned regarding the present situation of the Nationalist Government with regard to the rebellion of General Chang Fa-kuei and his Ironsides, General Cohen would only state that the matter was in entirely competent hands and that entire confidence reigned in Nanking. He further stated that General Chang Fa-kuei had no chance whatsoever of overthrowing the Central Government and that it was only a matter of a few weeks before the Ironsides would be completely wiped out. Furthermore, Nanking was absolutely confident that General Feng Yu-hsiang would not move against the Central Government in conjunction with General Chang Fa-kuei.

《字林西报》，1929年10月17日，星期四

科恩将军现居广州

已故孙中山博士的私人保镖重访该市

据《香港电讯报》驻广州记者报道，近期抵达广州的知名人士中包括莫里斯·A·科恩（Maurice A. Cohen）将军，他与南京的中国国民政府关系密切。科恩将军曾长期担任已故孙中山博士的私人保镖。自孙博士逝世后，他与广州及华南地区的政治运动保持着非常密切的联系。去年，他随胡汉民先生和孙科先生前往巴黎和伦敦，并受到奥斯汀·张伯伦爵士（Sir Austen Chamberlain）及其他英国政府重要成员的接见。

科恩将军于去年年底返回广州，在此停留约三个月，直到今年三月因已故孙中山博士的国葬事宜被召往南京和北京。值得注意的是，科恩将军是唯一一位乘坐孙中山灵车从北京前往南京的外国人。

此后，科恩将军一直与国民政府财政部保持密切联系。他此次访问广州是出于公务。尽管他不愿透露其公务性质，但据推测这与在广东恢复中央银行钞票有关。

当被问及国民政府针对张发奎将军及其“铁军”叛乱的当前局势时，科恩将军仅表示此事完全在掌控之中，南京方面充满信心。他进一步指出，张发奎将军绝无可能推翻中央政府，“铁军”将在几周内被彻底消灭。此外，南京方面绝对确信冯玉祥将军不会与张发奎将军联合行动对抗中央政府。

MORRIS ABRAHAM COHEN.

Morris Abraham Cohen, 41, was born in London of Jewish
parents on 3-2-1887. While he was still of school age,
his family moved to Alberta, Canada. He now considers
himself to be a Canadian and appears to be acquainted
with a large number of politicians in that country.
Reports received from Shanghai state that his career in
Canada was marked by connections with professional gamblers
and shady real estate business. He removed from Canada to
the U.S.A. and spent several years in New York. It was in
America that he first met the late Dr. SUN YAT SEN about
the year 1910. Since then he has been closely connected
with the activities of the Kuomintang political party in
China.

Cohen was in Canada at the outbreak of the Great War,
and there assisted in the organisation of the Chinese
Labour Corps. He later proceeded to England and France
with a railway battalion. After the war he returned to
the U.S.A. and resumed his old relations with the Canadian
branch of the Kuomintang. In 1923 he proceeded to Canton
at the instance of the Kuomintang party in Alberta. On
arrival in Canton he became the personal bodyguard to Dr.
SUN YAT SEN. Since then he has visited the U.S.A. several
times on Kuomintang business. His visits to U.S.A. were
probably with the intention of collecting funds for the
Kuomintang party, but H.B.M. Consul-General at Canton
wrote in 1925 that he was of opinion that smuggling of
Chinese into the North American Continent was probably
Cohen's real aim.

When Dr. SUN YAT SEN died in March 1925, Cohen was
unemployed for some time. In July 1925 he was acting as a
sort of liaison officer for the Commissioner of Police,
Canton, and later made several trips to Shanghai and the
North in connection with projects for extending the
pages.zh:
莫里斯·亚伯拉罕·科恩（MORRIS ABRAHAM COHEN）。

莫里斯·亚伯拉罕·科恩，41岁，1887年2月3日出生于伦敦，父母为犹太人。在他尚处学龄时，全家迁至加拿大阿尔伯塔省。他现在自视为加拿大人，似乎与该国众多政客相识。来自上海的报告称，他在加拿大的职业生涯以与职业赌徒和可疑房地产交易的联系为特征。他从加拿大移居美国，并在纽约度过了数年。正是在美国，他大约在1910年首次结识了已故的孙中山博士。此后，他一直与中国国民党的活动保持密切联系。

第一次世界大战爆发时，科恩身在加拿大，并在那里协助组织华工团。随后，他随一个铁路营前往英国和法国。战后，他返回美国，并恢复了与国民党加拿大分支的旧有关系。1923年，他应阿尔伯塔省国民党的邀请前往广州。抵达广州后，他成为孙中山博士的私人保镖。此后，他因国民党事务多次访问美国。他访问美国可能是为了为国民党筹集资金，但英国驻广州总领事在1925年写道，他认为科恩的真正目的可能是将中国人走私到北美大陆。

1925年3月孙中山博士逝世时，科恩失业了一段时间。1925年7月，他担任广州警察局局长的某种联络官，后来就扩展

pages.en:
Canton-Hankow Railway, and for developing the Canton
Harbour, under SUN FO (son of Dr. Sun Yat Sen) who was
then Commissioner of Reconstruction. Since then he appears
to have been liason officer for whatever party has been
in power in Canton, and at the end of 1927 he was in
Hong Kong purchasing army mules for General LI CHAI SUM.
He is known to have been in Russia, but the date of his
visit is not known. Although he claims to be a patriotic
Briton, his views are now entirely Chinese. According to
a report received from Shanghai at the end of 1925 Cohen
favours the abolition of Extraterritoriality, and points
to the treatment of Russian and Germans as evidence that
China is fit to assume judicial control over foreigners,
and that he visited Peking in 1925 for the purpose of
finding a formula to enable the governments of North and
South China to co-operate in matters effecting foreigners.
He left Hong Kong for Colombo on the S.S. President
Wilson on 28-1-28, together with SUN FO, C.C. WU, WU HON MAU
and NJ TIT SHING (WU TE CHEN), a party of Nationalist
Government officials proceeding to Europe, at the expense
of the Nanking Government, to study economic and political
conditions.
On 6-3-28 he arrived in Capetown, South Africa, travelling
on British passport No. I/1927 issued by H.B.M. Consul-
General at Canton, and stated he was visiting his sister
Mrs. BERNSTEIN of Market Square, Salisbury, South Africa,
and that he proposed to rejoin the Chinese officials at
the Chinese Legation in London.
He returned to Hong Kong alone, via Saigon, on 28-8-28
and proceeded to Canton on the next day. In January 1929
he was appointed A.D.C. to the military headquarters at
Canton, under Marshal LI CHAI SUM, and accompanied LI CHAI
SUM to Shanghai on the S.S. Empress of Russia which left
Hong Kong on 6-3-29.
19th March, 1929.

广汉铁路以及开发广州港的项目进行了几次往返上海和北方的旅行，这些项目是在时任重建委员的孙科（孙中山博士之子）领导下进行的。此后，他似乎一直是广州当权派的联络官，1927年底，他在香港为李济深将军购买军用骡马。已知他曾去过俄国，但访问日期不详。尽管他自称是爱国的英国人，但他的观点现在完全中国化。根据1925年底从上海收到的一份报告，科恩赞成废除治外法权，并以对俄国人和德国人的待遇为例，证明中国有能力接管对外国人的司法管辖权；他还称，他于1925年访问北京，目的是寻找一种方案，使中国南北政府能够在涉及外国人的事务上进行合作。
1928年1月28日，他与孙科、吴铁城（C.C. WU）、吴恒豪（WU HON MAU）和吴德贞（NJ TIT SHING，即 WU TE CHEN）一同乘“威尔逊总统”号轮船（S.S. President Wilson）离开香港前往科伦坡，这是一群由南京政府出资前往欧洲考察经济和政治状况的国民政府官员。
1928年3月6日，他抵达南非开普敦，持有英国驻广州总领事签发的第 I/1927 号英国护照，并称他是去探望住在南非索尔兹伯里市场广场的姐姐伯恩斯坦夫人（Mrs. BERNSTEIN），并计划在中国驻伦敦公使馆与中国官员会合。
1928年8月28日，他经西贡独自返回香港，并于次日前往广州。1929年1月，他被任命为广州李济深元帅军事总部的副官，并陪同李济深乘“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船前往上海，该船于1929年3月6日离开香港。
1929年3月19日。

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a London Jew named M.S.

ion of a bookmaker and has latterly been running the "Palladium

at present.

2. There are three convictions recorded against this man at
Scotland Yard for larceny and receiving and fine as suspected per-
son. His first conviction was in 1898, the last in 1904.

3. From England he seems to have gone to South Africa where it
is said he received three months for theft, and 18 months for bur-
glary but so far I have not been able to obtain any confirmation

4. From South Africa he went to India where he received 6 mths
for theft and 8 mths, for High-way Robbery. The last mentioned con-
viction was at Calcutta where he was also placed under Police Sup-
ervision.

5. Some years ago he managed by fraud or False Representation to
get Rs 500, from a Frenchman living at Criterion Hotel Rangoon and
made off with the money to Penang but he appears to have escaped
punishment for this offence as a friend of his Mr. Tully, Tin-miner
& bookmaker refunded the money to the Frenchman.

6. Cowan has recently been to South Africa, which country he vis-
ited with the express object of doing business in connection with
the import of teak but it is said that he made use of his time to
smuggle pearls with the assistance of his wife.

7. Cowan is about 41 years of age, his height is about 5' 4",
stout build, fair hair, fair complexion, brown eyes, clean shaven.

Sgd-Chief Police Officer,
SINGAPORE.

新加坡首席警官办公室，
1917 年 7 月 9 日。

第 11-1917 号。

先生：

谨此奉告，一名名为 M.S. Cowan（别名 Sydney Mark，又名 Myh Cohan）的伦敦籍犹太人，过去数年一直居住在新加坡，期间曾一度从事赌注登记人（bookmaker）职业，近期则经营“帕拉迪姆电影院”（Palladium Cinema-Theatre）。他正前往日本，表面上是担任一位名为 Goldenberg 的幻术师的先遣代理，该幻术师艺名为 Goldin，但有理由怀疑他另有目的，尽管目前尚不清楚具体目的为何。

2. 苏格兰场记录显示，此人有三项定罪记录，罪名分别为盗窃、收受赃物以及作为可疑人员被处罚金。他的首次定罪是在 1898 年，最近一次在 1904 年。

3. 他似乎从英国去了南非，据说他在当地因盗窃罪被判监禁三个月，因入室盗窃罪被判监禁十八个月，但截至目前，我未能获得对此事的任何证实。

4. 从南非他去了印度，在那里因盗窃罪被判监禁六个月，因抢劫罪被判监禁八个月。后一项定罪发生在加尔各答，他在那里也被置于警方监管之下。

5. 数年前，他通过欺诈或虚假陈述的手段，从居住在仰光 Criterion Hotel 的一名法国人那里骗得 500 卢比，并携款潜逃至槟城，但他似乎逃脱了对此罪行的惩罚，因为他的朋友 Tully 先生（锡矿主兼赌注登记人）向该法国人偿还了这笔钱。

6. Cowan 最近去过南非，他访问该国的明确目的是从事与柚木进口有关的业务，但据说他利用这段时间在其妻子的协助下走私珍珠。

7. Cowan 年龄约 41 岁，身高约 5 英尺 4 英寸，体格粗壮，金发，肤色白皙，褐色眼睛，面部无须。

签署-首席警官，
新加坡。
